featured_reviews.name: Cedric Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: A historic Roman Catholic Church located in Uttan. It was built by the Portuguese Franciscans between 1630 & 1634. This church was destroyed by the Marathas in 1739 and rebuilt in 1787. It is one of the oldest churches in Mumbai. Its interior is simple having wooden pews, windows, gold guided altar, side altars etc. The main altar had a barrel vaulted ceiling. There are tombstones inside and outside the church. The facade of this church had two belfry towers on either side. There is a small grotto at the side of the church. Had attended a mass service in this church in Marathi language. It is an ideal place for local devotees as well as people of other faith.

featured_reviews.name: Ammit P Chawda
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you happened to be at Gorai and Manauri please do visit this beautiful church next to the beach inside a Koli village a place where out fisher folks dwell!!
Their space is green and amazing and there is a sence of calmness and peace which you will definitely witness and love once you be here.

This Church is situated in Uttan bhatebandar built roughly 40 years ago it is inspired by the Holy Shrine and Church of Velankanni, Madras.

Highly Recommend place to visit around Bombay 🙏🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: Sudip Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Velankanni Church, Uttan (Bhayander)
The experience was truly peaceful and refreshing.

The beautiful church stairs, Mother Mary statue, and direct beach connection make this place special. The calm sea view and spiritual atmosphere create a perfect combination of devotion and nature.

✔ Free entry
✔ Sharing auto & bus available from Bhayander railway station
✔ Parking available for private vehicles
✔ Perfect for explorers and peaceful travellers
✔ Zero or Low Budget destination near Mumbai

If you love exploring new places, enjoying beach views, and experiencing positive vibes — this place is a must visit.

📍 Velankanni Church, Uttan – Bhayander

Best Time to Visit
✅ Early morning – peaceful prayer experience
✅ Evening sunset – beautiful sea view + calm environment
✅ September Feast – grand celebrations and novena masses

featured_reviews.name: Adrian Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beautiful Shrine of Our Lady to come and visit at any time. The place is always peaceful and quiet with lovely sea breeze blowing outside the church.
They have a big compound and if the gates are closed there is ample space to park outside too.
So parking is not an issue.
There is a huge statue of Mother Mary on the hill close by, which you can visit if your knees are in shape there are about 100+ steps to climb.

featured_reviews.name: Keith Dcruze
featured_reviews.review_text: If you are visiting the church make sure to go up and view the cross and mother Mary's statue. The view is amazing.

featured_reviews.name: Gilroy Quadros
featured_reviews.review_text:
A majestic Church that is surrounded by the sea.
The Masses here are in Marathi & the atmosphere is just peaceful & calming.

A must-visit if you are anywhere around Uttan!!

featured_reviews.name: Payal Dutta
featured_reviews.review_text: Another hidden crunch in Bhayandar, the church is so beautiful and also so quite that even sometimes the sound of waves of velankani sea beach can be heard from the church. Crowded on weekends and holidays, but must visit on weekday for surreal experience.
